scope: post-hoc exploratory design amendment after earlier manuscript results; fixed before this new analysis; not preregistered
camps: native classification retained in coverage audit; no verified native ensemble probability; ineligible for confidence-based methods; no invented probability
reference_metric: unit-cost global Levenshtein edit distance divided by maximum sequence length; nearest minimum over canonical reference sequences; whole-sequence distance, NOT MMseqs identity or earlier 90/80 overlap definition
inventory_reference: fixed model-specific available inventory; roles/completeness preserved; exact overlap retained; not proof of fitted training membership or independence
development_reference: selection-only sequences from other historical sources after held-source global group purge; query own global group excluded when constructing selection features; validation and held-source inputs never enter reference pool

features.C: clipped logit of probability assigned to saved native decision d*p+(1-d)*(1-p), clip 1e-6
features.I: nearest available inventory normalized edit distance
features.D: nearest selection-only development normalized edit distance

auxiliary_selector.target: native decision error against retained historical source label
auxiliary_selector.model: logistic linear error model; source-balanced record weights; weighted standardization using selection only
auxiliary_selector.failure: constant model for single error class; convergence recorded; no label-based rescue

tie_policy: retain ceil(coverage*n) weighted records; label-blind equal allocation at boundary ties; selection re-run within block bootstrap
diagnostic_high_confidence: saved-decision confidence >=0.95; q>=0.95 additionally audited; neither implies calibrated 95% correctness
diagnostic_distance_bins: selection source-balanced distance tertiles frozen before held-label evaluation; confidence bins <.8, .8-.95, >=.95

bootstrap.unit: global sequence-dependence group within held source
bootstrap.interval: exploratory pointwise percentile, >=95% valid, nondegenerate, >=5 groups; no multiplicity adjustment
bootstrap.conditional_scope: fixed selected training records, references and fitted auxiliary selectors; not full training/refit uncertainty

repeated_partitions: 20 reused held-source evaluations; sensitivity summaries NOT CIs or independent replications
experimental_extension: AMPlify confidence vs fixed SD, entropy gap and model-specific inventory similarity, within each of 4 cohorts and each of 2 primary tasks; no joint regression fitted on small experimental cohorts; same block/tie/bootstrap rules; smaller than 5 blocks descriptive
interpretation: historical source-label errors and experimental MIC-task errors reported separately; no causal failure mechanism, universal training independence, calibrated correctness or future risk guarantee
output: new folder only; no overwrite of original predictions/Word/GitHub/Zenodo; caches excluded from portable result ZIP
